sections.content: Attach -ban/-ben to say 'in' a room, following the vowel-harmony rule you already know. All four rooms in this lesson take -ban: a konyhában, a hálószobában, a fürdőszobában, a nappaliban.

items.english: The living room is bright and cozy.

items.spanish: A konyha a nappali mellett van.
items.english: The kitchen is next to the living room.

sections.content: For a compound word like fürdőszoba (bath + room), vowel harmony looks at the LAST part of the compound — szoba is back-vowel, so the whole word takes -ban, even though fürdő itself is front-vowel.
